metadata.description: assembl's plugin marketplace — file-based plugins for Claude Code and Claude Managed Agents, adapted to the NZ SME market. Eight ketes (industry packs) plus assembl-core baseline.

plugins.name: assembl-core
plugins.description: Core plugin — install first. Mandatory baseline skills (Privacy Act 2020, tikanga compliance, CGA, NZBN lookup) and core MCP connectors (NZBN, Companies Office).

plugins.name: waihanga
plugins.description: Construction industry pack (pilot — TOA Architecture). Building Act 2004, Construction Contracts Act 2002, NZS 3910, LBP licensing.

plugins.name: manaaki
plugins.description: Hospitality industry pack. Food Act 2014, Sale & Supply of Alcohol Act, MPI Food Control Plans.

plugins.name: pikau
plugins.description: Freight & customs industry pack (pilot — Aironaut Customs). Customs and Excise Act 2018, tariff classification, Goods Management Levy.

plugins.name: arataki
plugins.description: Tourism & visitor experience industry pack. Qualmark, ITO guidance, biosecurity declarations.

plugins.name: auaha
plugins.description: Creative industries pack. NZ Film Commission, copyright, contractor agreements.

plugins.name: ako
plugins.description: Education industry pack. NZQA, Teaching Council, Education and Training Act.

plugins.name: hoko
plugins.description: Retail & e-commerce industry pack. Consumer Guarantees Act, Fair Trading Act, GST.

plugins.name: toro
plugins.description: Professional services industry pack. AML/CFT Act, professional indemnity, scope of engagement.
